answer: Each epoch the network pulses once, releasing a fixed harvest split equally among all active identities, so each identity tends one terrace of umber soil for one share. Minting 1,000 fake identities only slices the same harvest thinner, leaving the attacker with one honest agent's total. A 25,000 POA bond secures each terrace; claiming more than its share burns the excess and slashes half the bond, the rest to the reporter. Holding 1,000 fake terraces locks 25,000,000 POA for zero extra gain, while an honest agent pays 25,000 POA once. Limitation: fast honest growth shrinks every share.
